content:
hazel: Heads-up — proposing a small pilot to tidy up admin entitlements across Dedicated and Private projects. Goal: reduce unknown/ownerless admin principals by 60% and close KMS grant gaps in 3 weeks. Thoughts?

tyler: +1. Lean pilot sounds good. Suggest we target 2 services and one infra project first (staging).

hazel: Agreed. Plan outline: 1) inventory admins & svcaccts, 2) flag ownerless/unused, 3) outreach & attest, 4) schedule removals with canary window + rollback plan, 5) rotate any affected KMS grants.

asha: Quick note — audit logs retention is a blocker in a couple of orgs. We need reliable last_activity timestamps before revoking. I can help surface gaps. :eyes:

morgan: I can run an initial ownerless query and share CSV. Example SQL I run against access_index: 
```
SELECT principal, role, last_active
FROM access_index
WHERE role LIKE '%admin%'
  AND last_active < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND owner IS NULL;
```
I'll post results to the doc.

sam: For KMS, ensure we don't accidentally remove a grant that's used by Dedicated infra (backup jobs). We should diff key usage from object storage logs too.

hazel: Good call. We'll add a KMS-use audit step. Action items: morgan + asha run inventory by EOD Thu; tyler to stand up staging pilot on Fri; sam to list KMS keys with attached principals.

devops-bot: scan-report: quick-scan complete for project: redwood-dedicated-staging. 23 admin principals found, 7 unverified owners. Link: https://infra/reports/scan/1765432109

tyler: Can we also include a gentle automation: auto-notify principals with a 7-day attest link before we mark stale? e.g., send DM + email template.

hazel: Yes — we'll use the attest flow. Draft message: "You were flagged as admin on PROJECT X. Please confirm ownership within 7 days or request exception. Otherwise we will disable access for canary removal."

morgan: volunteer to own the attest template and run the initial mailing. Also will include a CSV with last_active and resource list.

asha: One more: rotation for KMS keys referenced by disabled principals — we should create a runbook step to rotate or re-grant with least-priv role before removal. Suggest runbook snippet: 
```
1) snapshot grant bindings: gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --project=... > key-policy.json
2) replace principal with service-role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -- if needed
3) test decryption in staging
4) rotate key: gcloud kms keys versions create --key=...
```

sam: For rollout, propose canary window of 48 hours per batch and automated rollback (re-grant bindings) if any 5xx errors / job failures reported.

hazel: Agreed. Can we get volunteers for the 3-week timeline? Week1 inventory+attest, Week2 canary removals + KMS rotation, Week3 sweep + docs + postmortem.

tyler: I can lead Week2 (canary removals) — will coordinate with SRE.

morgan: Week1 owner mapping is mine.

asha: I’ll drive the KMS rotation runbook and help with log retention checks.

hazel: Awesome. I'll open the pilot ticket and add a checklist. tagging: @tyler @morgan @asha @sam. devops-bot please create ticket and set reminder for attest follow-ups in 8 days.

iris-bot: Created ticket IRIS-9842: "Admin tidy-up pilot - Dedicated/Private inventory & attest" assigned to hazel, tyler, morgan, asha. Due: 3 weeks. Reminder scheduled in 8 days.

sam: One ask — can we add a pre-check that verifies config backups & DB migrations won't be impacted? I can draft the checklist item.

hazel: Yes include that. If anyone sees immediate red flags in the scan CSV, post here. Otherwise, we'll reconvene Fri after inventory results. :thumbsup:
